correctness.rationale: For a labelled reflexive n-world relation, a singleton valuation {v} makes Δp false at w≠v exactly if (w,v) is an edge. Thus n singleton partitions reconstruct all off-diagonal entries; for n=2 a query is its own complementary split and suffices, and n=1 needs none. Against the universal relation, deleting (w_v,v) changes any answer only for the two complementary singleton valuations of v. Since n≥3 makes these n distinct partitions, even a deterministic adaptive protocol must ask all n on the universal-frame branch. For independent uniform valuations each prescribed split has probability 2^(1−n), and disjoint coupon categories yield the exact inclusion–exclusion formula. Factorial moments of missing splits at 2^(n−1)(log n+t) give Poisson(e^(−t)) and Gumbel. Independently enumerated all 4 reflexive n=2 frames and all 64 n=3 frames; minimal probe signatures and the n=3 singleton necessity matched. Limits: labelled, full truth-vector oracle, raw one-atom noncontingency, deterministic zero-error adaptive queries; no formulas with richer languages.
